question: How much does a pay monthly website cost?
answer: Our Website Starter package costs £79 per month plus VAT, with a £149 initial setup fee plus VAT. Additional pages and features are available at an extra cost.

question: Is there a minimum contract?
answer: Yes. Website Starter is based on a 24-month minimum agreement. Your contract will explain the payment terms, cancellation process and options for your website at the end of the agreement.

question: Can I use my existing domain name?
answer: Yes. If you already have a domain name, we can normally connect it to your new website, provided you have the necessary access.

question: Will my website appear on Google?
answer: Your website will include basic SEO setup to help search engines discover and understand its pages. However, appearing prominently for competitive searches usually requires additional optimisation and ongoing work.

question: Can I add more pages later?
answer: Yes. Additional pages and features can be quoted separately as your business grows.

question: Can you update my website?
answer: Limited content amendments are included within your package. Larger changes, additional functionality and redesigns can be quoted separately.

question: What happens if I cancel?
answer: Your agreement will set out cancellation terms, ownership and any options to purchase or transfer your website. We will explain these before you sign up.
